versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.2 of claw-sync introduces a major refactor and restructuring:

- Migrated all source code and scripts into a dedicated claw-sync/ subdirectory.
- Added example configuration and documentation files: README.md, SKILL.md, .gitignore, and config.example.env.
- Introduced modular scripts for pull, push, cron setup, and status operations.
- Updated command structure for improved usability and clarity.
- Removed the old root-level .gitignore file.

- Introduced unified command-line interface: /sync, /restore, /sync-status, /sync-list.
- Added index.js entry point to handle all sync, restore, status, and listing operations.
- Updated documentation to focus on simple commands and improved usage instructions.
- Maintained all security and disaster recovery features while simplifying usage.

Claw Sync 2.0.0: Major security and backup enhancements for OpenClaw syncing.

- Adds versioned backups with restore-any-version support.
- Introduces disaster recovery: creates local backup before any restore.
- Significantly improves security (no config or credential files synced; URL and path traversal protections).
- Defines exactly which files and directories are synced.
- New quick commands for push, pull, restore, version listing, and status checking.
- Full cross-platform support (Windows, Mac, Linux).
